resources.string: Lịch Việt – Meaning in every day
A thoughtful solar and Vietnamese lunar calendar for the days that matter. Calendar calculations run on your device, even without a connection.
Explore the Vietnamese lunar calendar, holidays, Heavenly Stems and Earthly Branches, solar terms and auspicious hours. Traditional date guidance is offered as cultural reference.
Save appointments, birthdays and lunar anniversaries. Choose repeats and reminder times that help you make time for the people you care about.
You can change these choices any time in Settings.
Show lunar dates on the calendar
Set up notifications after getting started
Lịch Việt asks for notification permission only when you choose setup or enable an event reminder. Precise reminders have a separate explanation, and you can always decide later.
